title: erosion is a rate, not a cliff

story.text:
# 💡 erosion is a rate, not a cliff
**concept** · shared · knowledge

Assurance decays continuously: a meet from four years ago is not a meet from Tuesday, and overlay recency (the '90 days?' question) is the same X6 finding arrived at independently from a map-rendering problem. The two clocks are asymmetric — your own trail never erodes. Not yet applied to the edge itself in the shipped model; named honestly as the open piece.
> *A meet from four years ago is not a meet from Tuesday.*
